consensus_method_note: Disparity is a 0-100 agreement metric combining direction-score dispersion and reversal-risk dispersion across Pass A, Pass B, and Pass C; lower is tighter agreement. The strongest allocation-qualified names had low disparity. Higher reversal risk excluded FFIV, CNC, APLD, AMKR, CDNS, and WELL even where direction scores looked interesting.
